cells.precision: Mixed F16/F32 GGUF from pinned Piperlite FP16 source; precision preserved across CPU and WebGPU.

settings.seed: Base seed = 42 + zero-based canonical span ID (uint32); Kokopop derives internal long-form chunk seeds.
settings.textInput: Harness passes each raw canonical span to Kokopop LONG_FORM synthesis without pre-splitting it.
settings.textNormalization: Kokopop LONG_FORM normalizes text, then the pinned Piper eSpeak/NFD frontend emits phoneme IDs with interleaved PAD.
settings.internalLongFormChunking: Kokopop chunks to the voice-adjusted model token budget; it may trim/crossfade chunks and insert pauses.
settings.streamDecode: Offline synthesis returns PCM after Kokopop collects the internally generated long-form chunks.
settings.espeakLanguageData: English data from the matching Kokopop bundle; selected upstream eSpeak voice en

capability.description: Explicit CPU/WASM mode of the same Kokopop runtime and selected locked Sano GGUF.
